career_overview.short_description: Build responsive, native or cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android devices.
responsibilities: Design and build accessible, responsive mobile user interfaces
Manage mobile application state, navigation, and offline data persistence
Integrate device hardware APIs including camera, location, and biometrics
Connect mobile apps to REST and GraphQL backend services with background sync
Test, profile, and publish applications to the Apple App Store and Google Play
representative_work: A cross-platform mobile application featuring interactive UI screens, local SQLite offline storage, device camera integration, API data sync, and automated mobile tests.
core_skills: Mobile performance profiling and memory analysis
App signing and app store release management

roadmap.title: Mobile Developer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor, terminal and modern browser. Most tasks use free software or local runtimes.
roadmap.final_outcome: A cross-platform mobile application featuring interactive UI screens, local SQLite offline storage, device camera integration, API data sync, and automated mobile tests.
